title: Two cases of tooth resorption in patients receiving denosumab therapy
html: Multiple external cervical root resorption (MECRR) is a rare, aggressive form of root resorption affecting multiple permanent teeth at the cementoenamel junction. A possible association between denosumab (DMAb), a receptor activator of nuclear factor-κB ligand (RANKL)-inhibiting antiresorptive medication, and MECRR has been proposed, although evidence remains limited.
